annotations.title: Market-observed gap between public adverts and the official rate

description: A dated series per currency of the gap between a public-advert median and the official rate. Labelled market-observed, never an official rate. Currencies: ZAR, MZN, MWK, ZMW, NGN, KES, BRL, ARS, PHP. Too few adverts, or no read on record, is null with a reason. A missing gap is never zero. Free.
name: parallel_signal
